spans.s: पक्कण m. The hut of a savage or barbarian.
पक्ति f. 1. Cooking; 2. digestion; 3. ripening, becoming ripe; 4. fame, dignity.
पक्ति-शूल n. violent pain of the bowels proceeding from indigestion.
पक्तृ m. Fire.
पक्त्र n. The state of a householder who keeps a sacred fire.
पक्त्रिम a. (f. मा) 1. Ripe, ripened; 2. mature.
पक्त्रिम a. (f. मा) 1. Ripe, ripened; 2. mature.

पक्व a. (f. क्वा) 1. Cooked, boiled, as in पक्वान्न; 2. digested; 3. baked, burned, e.g. पक्वेष्टकानामाकर्षणम्, or तदन्न पक्वेष्टके पूर्णकुंभ एव शोभते Mrich.iii.; 4. mature, ripe, पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठी Megh.ii.19); 5. fully developed, come to perfection; 6. shrewd; 7. on the eve of decay.

पक्व a. (f. क्वा) 1. Cooked, boiled, as in पक्वान्न; 2. digested; 3. baked, burned, e.g. पक्वेष्टकानामाकर्षणम्, or तदन्न पक्वेष्टके पूर्णकुंभ एव शोभते Mrich.iii.; 4. mature, ripe, पक्वबिंबाधरोष्ठी Megh.ii.19); 5. fully developed, come to perfection; 6. shrewd; 7. on the eve of decay.
पक्व-अतिसार m. chronic dysentery.
पक्व-अन्न n. cooked food.
पक्व-आधान n. the stomach, abdomen.
पक्व-आशय m. the stomach, abdomen.
पक्व-इष्टका f. a baked brick, Mrich.iii.
पक्व-रस m. spirituous liquor.
पक्व-वारि n. the water of boiled rice.
पक्वश m. Name of a barbarous tribe.
पक्ष् vt. 1P, 10U (pres. पक्षति, पक्षयति-ते) 1. To take, to seize; 2. to accept; 3. to take a side.

पक्ष m. 1. A lunar fortnight (of which there are two, the शुक्र or bright and the कृष्ण or dark fortnight), तमिस्रपक्षेऽपि सहप्रियाभिर्ज्योत्स्नावतो निर्विशति प्रदोषान् R.vi.34; 2. a wing, a feather, स पूर्वतः पर्वतपक्षशातनं ददर्श R.iii.42, 60, iv.40; 3. the feathers on both sides of an arrow, Sis.xx.11 (where the word is used in this sense and in sense 17); 4. the flank, the side; 5. the side of an animal, the shoulder, R.v.72; 6. a party, a faction, Sis.ii.117, R.vi.53, Bg.xiv.25; 7. a partisan, a follower; 8. an alternative, पूर्व एवाभवत्पक्षस्तस्मिन्नाभवदुत्तरः R.iv.10, xiv.34; 9. a thesis, a point under discussion; 10. state, condition; 11. a bird; 12. the body; 13. a royal elephant; 14. an army; 15. a limb of the body; 16. a wall; 17. the subject of a syllogism or inference; (it is thus defined- संदिग्धसाध्यवान्पक्षः) (in logic); 18. (in composition with words signifying ‘hair’) mass, quantity. Cf. हस्त.
पाक्ष a. (f. क्षी) 1. Belonging to a lunar fortnight; 2. relating to a party.
पक्ष-अंत m. the 15th day of either half month, i.e. the day of new or full moon.
पक्ष-अंतर n. 1. another side; 2. a different view of an argument; 3. another supposition.
पक्ष-आघात m. 1. paralysis of one side; 2. refutation of an argument.
पक्ष-आहार m. eating food only once in a fortnight.
पक्ष-हर m. a bird.
पक्ष-ग्रहण n. choosing a party.
पक्ष-चर ??? 1. an elephant strayed from the herd; 2. the moon.
पक्ष-च्छिद् m. an epithet of Indra.
पक्ष-ज m. the moon.
पक्ष-द्वय n. 1. both sides of an argument; 2. a couple of fortnights.
पक्ष-द्वार n. a side-door, a private entrance.
पक्ष-धर m. 1. a bird; 2. a partisan; 3. the moon; 4. an elephant strayed from the herd.
पक्ष-नाडी f. a quill.
पक्ष-पात m. 1. the moulting of birds; 2. siding with anyone; 3. partiality, सत्यं जना वच्मि न पक्षपातात् Bhartr.i.47.
पक्ष-पातिन् a. 1. partial, attached; 2. moving the wings, Na.ii.52 (where the word is used in both the senses).
पक्ष-पालि m. a private door.
पक्ष-बिंदु m. a heron.
पक्ष-भाग m. the side or flank, especially that of an elephant.
पक्ष-भुक्ति f. the course traversed by the sun in a fortnight.
पक्ष-मूल n. the root of a wing.
पक्ष-वाद m. 1. an ex-parte statement; 2. expression of opinion.
पक्ष-वाहन m. a bird.
पक्ष-हत a. paralysed on one side.
पक्ष-होम m. a sacrificial rite lasting a fortnight.
पक्षक m. 1. A side-door; 2. a side; 3. an associate, a partisan.
पक्षति f. 1. The root of a wing, अलिखच्चंचुपुटेन पक्षती Na.ii.2; 2. the first day of a lunar fortnight.
पक्षालु m. A bird.
पक्षिणी f. 1. A female bird; 2. a night with the two days enclosing it (द्वावह्नावेकरात्रिश्च पक्षिणीत्यभिधीयते) (in religious law).
पक्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Furnished with wings; 2. siding with.
पक्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) 1. Furnished with wings; 2. siding with.
पक्षिन् (II) m. 1. A bird, M.i.44; 2. an arrow; 3. an epithet of Śiva.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-इंद्र, -प्रवर, -राज्, -राज, -सिंह, -स्वामिन् m. An epithet of Garuḍa.
पक्षिन्-कीट m. an insignificant bird.
पक्षिन्-बालक, -शावक m. a young bird.
पक्षिन्-बालक, -शावक m. a young bird.
पक्षिन्-शाला f. 1. nest; 2. an aviary.
पक्ष्मन् n. 1. An eyelash, Megh.i.47, R.ii.19; 2. the filament of a flower; 3. the point of a thread; 4. a wing.
पक्ष्मल a. (f. ला) 1. Having long or beautiful eyelashes; 2. hairy, shaggy, मृदितपक्ष्मलरल्लकांगः Sis.iv.61.
पक्ष्मल a. (f. ला) 1. Having long or beautiful eyelashes; 2. hairy, shaggy, मृदितपक्ष्मलरल्लकांगः Sis.iv.61.
पक्ष्य m. A partisan, a follower, an ally, ननु वज्रिण एव वीर्यमेतद्विजयते द्विषतो यदस्य पक्ष्याः Vikr.i.

पाक m. 1. Cooking, baking, boiling; 2. burning (as bricks), M.v.122, 123; 3. digestion; 4. ripeness, फलमभिनवपाकं राजजंबूद्रुमस्य Vikr.iv.; 5. perfect development; 6. completion, accomplishment, युयोज पाकाभिमुखैर्भृत्यान्विज्ञापानाफलैः R.xvii.40; 7. consequences of an act done; 8. hoariness of hair consequent on old age; 9. a domestic fire; 10. an owl; 11. grain, corn, R.v.9; 12. fruit, fruition, आशीर्भिरेधयामासुः परःपाकाभिरंबिकाम् K.S.vi.90; 13. a child, a young one; 14. name of a demon killed by Indra.
पाक-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -शाला ऋ।, -स्थान न्। m.n. a kitchen.
पाक-अगार, -आगार म्।न्।, -शाला ऋ।, -स्थान न्। m.n. a kitchen.
पाक-शाला f. a kitchen.
पाक-स्थान n. a kitchen.
पाक-अतीसार m. chronic dysentery.
पाक-अभिमुख a. ready for development, inclined to favour.
पाक-ज n. 1. black salt; 2. flatulence.
पाक-पात्र n. a cooking utensil.
पाक-पुटी f. a potter’s kiln.
पाक-यज्ञ m. a domestic sacrifice; (several varieties of it are mentioned), M.ii.143.
पाक-शुक्ला f. chalk.
पाक-शासन m. an epithet of Indra, K.S.ii.63.
पाक-शासनि m. 1. an epithet of Jayanta, son of Indra; 2. an epithet of Vāli; 3. of Arjuna.
पाकल m. 1. Fire; 2. wind; 3. fever in an elephant. Cf. कूटपाकल.
पाकिम a. (f. मा) 1. Cooked; 2. ripened (naturally or artificially).
पाकिम a. (f. मा) 1. Cooked; 2. ripened (naturally or artificially).
पाकु m. A cook.
पाकु m. A cook.
पाक्य (I) a. (f. क्या) To be cooked.
पाक्य (II) m. Salt-petre.
पाक्य (I) a. (f. क्या) To be cooked.
पाक्ष a. (f. क्षी) 1. Belonging to a lunar fortnight; 2. relating to a party.
पाक्षिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Belonging to a fortnight; 2. belonging to a bird; 3. favouring a party or faction; 4. optional, allowed but not prescribed, e.g. नियमः पाक्षिके सति.
पाक्षिक (II) m. A fowler.
पाक्षिक (I) a. (f. की) 1. Belonging to a fortnight; 2. belonging to a bird; 3. favouring a party or faction; 4. optional, allowed but not prescribed, e.g. नियमः पाक्षिके सति.
